name: portable
toml:
algorithm = "random"
fixedArgs = []
machineSizeId = "nano"
maxFailedTrialCount = 3
maxRuntimeSecondsPerTrial = 60
maxTrialCount = 10
parallelTrialCount = 1
region = "eu-west"
reportingMode = "stdout"
useCustomDockerImage = false
requiredEnv = []

[metricPolicies]
[[objectives]]
name = "latency"
type = "minimize"

[[objectives]]

min = 0.0001

slug = "learning-rate"
type = "double"

[[parameters]]
max = 0.5
min = 0
name = "dropout"
slug = "dropout"
